messages:
ashley_support: FYI customer GlowRetail reporting a sudden wave of 504s + gateway 5xx on hosted inference. Started ~09:12 UTC, affecting their checkout autocomplete endpoint.
deploy-bot: ALERT: 504 spike detected in us-east-1 -- 1,220 errors in last 5m. Auto-page sent. Runbook 'ingress-queue-surge' invoked.
matt_infra: Can someone grab queue depth + batcher backlog for ingress-1? suspect continuous-batching backlog.jeff_sre: grabbing now — output below (snipped):
```
$ redwoodctl queue status --region us-east-1 --pool ingress-1
queue_depth: 1200 (limit: 1024)
queue_head_latency_p95_ms: 3100
continuous_batch_pending: 3480
avg_dequeue_rate_qps: 420
per-tenant_hotspot: GlowRetail tenant_id=tr_glow (3.4x baseline)
errors: upstream_timeout=732, gateway_504=1210
```
This looks like the queue hit the configured cap and we've been dropping/returning 504s.
anita_prod: we rolled the continuous-batching window tweak (50ms -> 150ms) to canary last night and promoted at 02:00 UTC for all ingresses. Might be interacting poorly with a tenant burst pattern.
matt_infra: immediate mitigation options: 1) disable continuous_batching on ingress-1, 2) temporarily raise queue_depth limit (to 4096), 3) enable per-tenant soft-throttle for GlowRetail. I'll run 1+2 now.
dana_engineering: reproducer I used locally (small loop to mimic their burst):
```
for i in {1..2000}; do curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood-hosted/v1/generate \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer <key>' \
  -d '{"model":"gpt-xl","input":"autocomplete: product query"}' &
done
wait
```
If you send many concurrent short requests that all miss KV cache and have similar prefixes the batcher queues up a lot and each worker stalls on KV loads.
jeff_sre: matt — I applied disable continuous_batching on ingress-1 and increased queue limit to 4096 as a hotfix. Monitoring: queue_depth dropped to ~920 within 90s, p95 head latency down to 1800ms, gateway 504s trending down.
matt_infra: thanks. we should still investigate why 150ms window made things worse: hypothesis = longer batching window increased tail queuing when a tenant floods with many short requests that can't be coalesced (KV cache thrash). We need telemetry: batch fill factor, per-batcher KV miss rate.
anita_prod: agree. next steps: 1) collect batcher traces for the period 08:50-09:20 UTC, 2) run controlled repro against a staging pool with the 150ms setting, 3) draft config for per-tenant concurrency limit and burst window.
ashley_support: customer wants timeline + repro + mitigation details. I'm preparing an update. Please include exact command snippets so support can reproduce and confirm.
dana_engineering: putting repro runbook into thread: 1) create staging tenant with same rate-limit key, 2) run the curl flood above with 2-3k concurrent requests, 3) observe continuous_batch_pending and queue_depth metrics on /metrics and redwoodctl. If you want I can share a small script.
jeff_sre: capture note — we should also add an alert for continuous_batch_pending > 2000 for 1m to avoid silent pileups. I'll open a PagerDuty rule PR.
matt_infra: i'll own the follow-up config change (per-tenant soft-throttle + revert default continuous-batching window to 50ms for now). dana, can you run the staged repro with the 150ms and 50ms to show delta? aim for before EOD.
ashley_support: sending initial customer message: "Root cause appears to be a tenant-origin burst coupled with a recent batching window change; we've applied hotfixes (disabled continuous batching + raised queue limit) and are running repros to recommend config. Will follow up with timeline+next steps." :thumbsup:
deploy-bot: RUNBOOK: incident marked P2. Owners assigned: matt_infra (infra mitigation), dana_engineering (repro), jeff_sre (monitoring/alerts), anita_prod (prod config review).
note: short thread, quick triage + hotfix; customer communication ongoing
